subject: general
question: What is the destination of the water drained off by the Nile river?
solution:
The correct answer is **Mediterranean Sea**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Nile River** is the longest river in the world, flowing through northeastern Africa.
 
• It has **two major tributaries**: the White Nile and the Blue Nile, which meet in Sudan.
 
• The river flows **northward through the desert**, creating a fertile valley across Egypt before draining into the Mediterranean Sea.
 
• The Nile's drainage into the Mediterranean Sea is crucial for **agriculture and civilization** in Egypt, providing fertile soil and supporting ancient and modern societies.

 [IMAGE: https://www.worldatlas.com/r/w768/upload/5e/1f/d6/nile-river-in-egypt-map.png] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Lake Victoria
 It is the source of the White Nile and is located in east-central Africa.
 
 

 Indian Ocean
 The Indian Ocean is the third-largest ocean, bounded by Asia, Africa, Australia, and the Southern Ocean, key for major global trade routes and rich in biodiversity. It significantly influences climate patterns, including the monsoon system, and faces environmental issues like overfishing and pollution.
 
 

 Lake Tanganyika
 One of the African Great Lakes, not directly connected to the Nile River system.
